headline.text: 14 issues cleared in 24 hours; L1 marshmallow commissioning continues tuning, and *3 material or quality holds* remain active.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran production across S2, S3, and S4 with brief pauses for a caramel shortage and capper adjustment—both cleared same-shift. S1 commissioning hit marshmallow density challenges; recipe change allowed the pump to work but parameters still need dialing. Bequet cellophane arrived midday. Coconut cashews down to final 3.5 hours of material.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ran FFS and three moulding lines with no prolonged stoppages. ML2 paused for a laser printer fix during changeover to bulk SKU; approved and running by 00:06. FFS stopped briefly for X-ray calibration.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 Truffle line was down 1 hour 42 minutes for belt slipping—cleared by adding tension and deep-cleaning rollers. Flow wrap on Truffle flagged defective rolls with glue out of position; QA placed on hold. ML1 flush delayed by de-crystallizer valve issue at window close; maintenance on-site.

resolved.title: S2 kitchen ran out of caramel
resolved.summary: SCM was colder than expected, taking longer to fill; kitchen exhausted caramel supply and line paused 20 minutes to catch up.
resolved.resolution: Team found and switched to a warmer tote by 03:20; line resumed.

resolved.title: Bequet cellophane shortage
resolved.summary: S1 had 10 rolls of Bequet FW left (~3 hours); vendor missed Friday shipment, FedEx delivery scheduled for Thursday.
resolved.resolution: FedEx shipment (41273) arrived to SV at 13:00 per Ethan Bean.

resolved.title: S1 enrober not filled with chocolate
resolved.summary: Enrober on S1 was empty at shift start; operator got PSI alarm and pump fault trying to fill, traced to infeed pipe on wrong side of enrober.
resolved.resolution: First shift lead changed the pipe to correct side and filled enrober by 18:10.

resolved.title: S3 target depositor clog
resolved.summary: Line paused to unclog the target depositor and perform CILT work.
resolved.resolution: Line running again at 22:37 per William Beattie.

resolved.title: S2 Allfill capper timing delayed on jams
resolved.summary: When caps stuck, white tamping block took too long to activate and clear the jam; cap chute high eye was on all the time, delaying the tamping cycle start.
resolved.resolution: Leon adjusted the cap chute high eye by removing wing nut; timing looks better.

resolved.title: Water hose crack in dishwashing area 3
resolved.summary: Hose had a crack and was spraying water throughout the dishwashing area.
resolved.resolution: William repaired the hose by 13:08; working without leaks.

resolved.title: Kitchen staffing request for S1 marshmallow commissioning
resolved.summary: Two kitchens (Kitchen 1 and Marshmallow Kitchen 1) required simultaneous operation; single operator struggling to keep up with mixing and cooking across both locations.
resolved.resolution: Justin confirmed kitchen operators already assigned to work with Marcos at 11:44.

resolved.title: ML2 laser printer issue during changeover to bulk 100
resolved.summary: Packing changeover to bulk 100 completed but laser printer needed maintenance work before approval to run.
resolved.resolution: Hervin approved print quality at 23:46, water test passed at 23:57, line running at 00:06.

resolved.title: FFS line stopped for X-ray calibration
resolved.summary: Line paused while X-ray machine was being calibrated.
resolved.resolution: Line running at 16:18 per Mathew Draper.

resolved.title: Truffle line belt slipping
resolved.summary: Line down at 06:32; belt slipping despite previous tension adjustment, requiring deep cleaning of scraper, rollers, and belt underside plus additional tension.
resolved.resolution: Kavin and Blake added tension, cleaned buildup; line started at 08:14 per Rich at 1.75 ppm.

resolved.title: ML4 defective flow-wrap roll with silver outline
resolved.summary: One flow-wrap roll found defective near end of roll; lettering had silver-colored outline, failing QA standards.
resolved.resolution: Roll replaced and already-packaged chocolate unwrapped and repackaged per 08:32 message.

resolved.title: Truffle line inspection conveyor stopping
resolved.summary: One of the conveyors where product is inspected before packaging kept stopping; drive belt found to be bad and not in inventory.
resolved.resolution: Nathan reported "Dorner is running again" at 10:08.

resolved.title: ML4 TG5 down for chain adjustment
resolved.summary: TG5 stopped at 09:20 for Peter to make adjustments to the chain.
resolved.resolution: TG5 running back at 09:40; was actually loose brush inside forming parts, not chain, per 10:03 update.

resolved.title: ML4 WDS stopped by gondola work
resolved.summary: Marco did something in the gondola that stopped WDS at 11:51.
resolved.resolution: Running at 11:55 per Itzel; operators used pause to unclog water drain on depositor 2.

needs_attention.title: S1 marshmallow production parameters out of spec
needs_attention.summary: Hyfoama pumping/dosing system issues prevented hitting density and water activity targets; recipe change test at 10:36 allowed pump to work, but kitchen parameters need further dialing before marshmallow can be made correctly.
needs_attention.status: Recipe change successful in allowing pump operation; Volker needs to dial in kitchen parameters before final confirmation, as of 10:36.

needs_attention.title: S3 coconut cashews material running low
needs_attention.summary: Down to last 2 pallets of coconut cashews with approximately 3.5 hours of run time remaining plus whatever is on the bed.
needs_attention.status: Last 2 pallets flagged at 13:23; no inbound delivery confirmation by window close.

needs_attention.title: S1 reed switches/proximity sensors on MM9/10 pulled from position
needs_attention.summary: Reed switches and proximity sensors on MM9/10 were found pulled out from their proper location; no explanation or resolution posted.
needs_attention.status: Caleb flagged sensors out of position at 16:56; no follow-up by window close.

needs_attention.title: Truffle flow wrap rolls with glue in wrong position
needs_attention.summary: Some flow wrap rolls have glue in the wrong position; QA has been notified and rolls will be placed on hold at end of shift.
needs_attention.status: QA notified at 12:27; rolls to be held at shift end per operator message.

needs_attention.title: ML1 de-crystallizer valve failure preventing flush
needs_attention.summary: Unable to perform scheduled flush at 13:20 due to issues with the de-crystallizer valve; maintenance on-site working to resolve.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance on-site working on valve as of 13:40; flush still pending at window close.
